plugin.name: PortalMapper
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Walks a bag of handheld portals and records every one as a mapper portal exit

muclient.script:
-- gmcphelper gives gmcp() and Send_GMCP_Packet(). Guarded in case a -- stripped down client does not ship it. local gHaveGmcpHelper = pcall (require, "gmcphelper")
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours - the house theme -- ===================================================================== local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 local CLR_WARN = "#FF5F00" -- x202, used for the "cannot portal here" line
local TAG = "PortalMapper"
local ITEM_TYPE_PORTAL = 20 -- aardwolf.com/wiki Help/Invdata local ENTER_TIMEOUT = 5 -- seconds to wait for a new room after "enter" local SCAN_TIMEOUT = 8 -- seconds to wait for the invdata reply local REC_DELAY = 0.5 -- seconds to let the mapper answer fullportal local REC_RETRIES = 3 -- attempts before giving up on one portal local MAPPER_ID = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714" -- Aardwolf_GMCP_Mapper
-- ===================================================================== -- Echo helpers -- ===================================================================== local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function echoWarn (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_WARN, "", msg) end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-30s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
-- ===================================================================== -- State -- ===================================================================== local gCfg = { bag = nil, -- object serial of the portal bag dualweapon = nil, -- object serial re-equipped with "dual" (no-wish mode) wearportal = nil, -- object serial re-equipped with "wear" (wish mode) wish = false, }
local gMapped = {} -- [serial] = { room = "1234", level = "50", name = "..." } local gDebug = false
local gRoomNum = nil -- last room.info num, as a string
local gScan = nil -- { want = "run"|"list", items = {}, ticks = 0 } local gRun = nil -- { queue = {}, index = 0, stopping = false } local gStep = "idle" -- "idle" | "scanning" | "entering" local gCurrent = nil -- portal being walked right now local gFromRoom= nil -- room we entered it from local gTicks = 0 local gSawSame = false -- room.info re-sent the SAME room while we waited
local gRec = nil -- { portal, room, tries } while the mapper is storing an exit local gRecGen = 0 -- generation counter for the delayed check local gRecFail = nil -- a mapper "PORTAL ... FAILED" line seen while recording local gRecOk = false -- the mapper's "Storing ... as a portal" line was seen
local function dbg (msg) if gDebug then ColourNote ("#FFAF00", "", "[" .. TAG .. " debug] " .. msg) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Small helpers -- =====================================================================
-- Aardwolf item names carry @ colour codes. Strip them for display. local function stripColours (s) if not s then return "" end s = string.gsub (s, "@x%d%d%d", "") s = string.gsub (s, "@[a-zA-Z]", "") s = string.gsub (s, "@@", "@") return s end
local function trim (s) s = string.gsub (s or "", "^%s+", "") s = string.gsub (s, "%s+$", "") return s end
local function countMapped () local n = 0 for _ in pairs (gMapped) do n = n + 1 end return n end
-- The separator to put between stacked commands inside the {curly braces} -- of "mapper fullportal". -- -- The mapper stores whatever it is given and later does gsub(";", stack_char) -- when it turns a portal exit into a speedwalk, so what it must END UP with -- is single semicolons. Execute() is processed as if typed, and with command -- stacking on, a doubled stack character collapses to one literal character. -- So we double it only when the stack character actually is ";". local function separator () local ok, enabled = pcall (GetOption, "enable_command_stack") if ok and enabled == 1 then local ok2, ch = pcall (GetAlphaOption, "command_stack_character") if ok2 and ch == ";" then return ";;" end end return ";" end
-- The one difference between the two modes. -- -- TWO LAYERS HERE, AND THE DIFFERENCE MATTERS. -- -- restoreToken() is the WORD that goes into the command stored in the -- mapper: literally "dualweapon" or "wearportal". It is NOT an item -- number. This plugin defines an alias of that exact name, so when the -- mapper later walks the portal the word expands to whatever weapon or -- portal item you are using TODAY. Map a portal at level 50 wearing one -- item, re-gear at 201 with a different one, and the stored exit still -- works - nothing to rewrite. -- -- That only works because the mapper runs portal commands through -- ExecuteWithWaits -> Execute (aard_GMCP_mapper.xml), which applies alias -- processing. Send() would not. If a future package version ever changes -- that to Send(), these words would go to the mud raw and every portal -- would break; that is the one thing to re-check on a package update. -- -- restoreLive() is the real command, used when the word has to be turned -- into something the mud understands. local function restoreToken () if gCfg.wish then return "wearportal" end return "dualweapon" end
-- Same trick for the bag: the stored command says "portalbag", never a bag -- number, so moving every portal into a new bag is one setting change and -- nothing else. Matched by the "get <n> portalbag" / "put <n> portalbag" -- aliases below. local function bagToken () return "portalbag" end
local function restoreLive () if gCfg.wish then return "wear " .. tostring (gCfg.wearportal or "<not set>") end return "dual " .. tostring (gCfg.dualweapon or "<not set>") end
-- The exact round trip, as recorded and as run. -- -- Built from bag + restore rather than read from a stored string, so that -- "portalmapper rewrite" can regenerate the OLD command (from what each -- record says was in force at the time) and the NEW one side by side. local function portalCommandFor (serial, bag, restore) local sep = separator () return table.concat ({ "get " .. serial .. " " .. bag, "wear " .. serial, "enter", "remove " .. serial, restore, "put " .. serial .. " " .. bag, }, sep) end
local function portalCommand (serial) return portalCommandFor (serial, bagToken (), restoreToken ()) end
-- Portals recorded with a bag or a restore step that is no longer current. -- Changing bags, swapping your dual weapon, or flipping wish mode makes -- every previously recorded exit stale, because the command string stored -- in the mapper still names the old items. local function staleList () local stale = {} local restore = restoreToken () local bag = bagToken () for serial, m in pairs (gMapped) do if m.bag and m.restore and (m.bag ~= bag or m.restore ~= restore) then table.insert (stale, serial) end end table.sort (stale) return stale end
-- Is the Aardwolf mapper there to take our exits? local function mapperReady () if not IsPluginInstalled (MAPPER_ID) then return false, "the Aardwolf mapper plugin is not installed." end if GetPluginInfo (MAPPER_ID, 17) == false then return false, "the Aardwolf mapper plugin is disabled." end return true end
-- Read-only look at the mapper's own database. local function openMapperDb () local name = GetPluginVariable (MAPPER_ID, "db_name") if not name or name == "" then return nil end local ok, db = pcall (sqlite3.open, GetInfo (66) .. name .. ".db") if not ok or not db then return nil end pcall (function () db:busy_timeout (200) end) return db end
-- Is this portal's exit in the mapper, the way 'mapper portals' would list -- it (exit from anywhere, destination room known)? room is optional. -- true / false, or nil if the database could not be queried. local function exitInMapper (db, serial, room) local q = "SELECT 1 FROM exits LEFT OUTER JOIN rooms ON rooms.uid = exits.touid " .. "WHERE exits.fromuid IN ('*','**') AND rooms.area IS NOT NULL " .. "AND exits.dir LIKE '%wear " .. serial .. ";enter%' " .. (room and ("AND CAST(exits.touid AS TEXT) = '" .. room .. "' ") or "") .. "LIMIT 1" local ok, found = pcall (function () for _ in db:nrows (q) do return true end return false end) if not ok then return nil end return found end
-- What is still missing before a run can start? local function missingConfig () local missing = {} if not gCfg.bag then table.insert (missing, "portalmapper bag <id>") end if gCfg.wish then if not gCfg.wearportal then table.insert (missing, "portalmapper wearportal <id>") end else if not gCfg.dualweapon then table.insert (missing, "portalmapper dualweapon <id>") end end return missing end
-- ===================================================================== -- Data file -- -- Settings and the mapped list live together in one plain text file next -- to the plugin. GetPluginInfo(id, 6) is the .xml FILE path, not the -- folder - gluing a name straight on silently produces -- "PortalMapper.xml_data.txt", so trim back to the last separator. -- ===================================================================== local function dataPath () local pluginFile = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 6) or "" local pluginDir = string.match (pluginFile, "^(.*[\\/])") or "" return pluginDir .. "PortalMapper_data.txt" end
local function saveData () local path = dataPath () local f, err = io.open (path, "w") if not f then echoWarn ("could not write " .. path .. ": " .. tostring (err)) return false end
f:write ("# PortalMapper data - settings and mapped portals.\n") f:write ("# set <name> <value>\n") f:write ("# map <serial>|<room>|<level>|<bag>|<restore step>|<name>\n") f:write ("# The bag and restore step are the ones in force WHEN IT WAS RECORDED,\n") f:write ("# which is how 'portalmapper rewrite' knows what to change.\n") if gCfg.bag then f:write ("set bag " .. gCfg.bag .. "\n") end if gCfg.dualweapon then f:write ("set dualweapon " .. gCfg.dualweapon .. "\n") end if gCfg.wearportal then f:write ("set wearportal " .. gCfg.wearportal .. "\n") end f:write ("set wish " .. (gCfg.wish and "1" or "0") .. "\n")
local serials = {} for s in pairs (gMapped) do table.insert (serials, s) end table.sort (serials) for _, s in ipairs (serials) do local m = gMapped [s] f:write (string.format ("map %s|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s\n", s, m.room, m.level, m.bag or "", m.restore or "", m.name or "")) end
f:close () return true end
local function loadData () gCfg.bag, gCfg.dualweapon, gCfg.wearportal = nil, nil, nil gCfg.wish = false gMapped = {}
local f = io.open (dataPath (), "r") if not f then return end
for raw in f:lines () do local line = trim (raw) if line ~= "" and string.sub (line, 1, 1) ~= "#" then local key, value = string.match (line, "^set%s+(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if key then if key == "wish" then gCfg.wish = (value == "1") elseif key == "bag" or key == "dualweapon" or key == "wearportal" then gCfg [key] = value end else -- current format: map serial|room|level|bag|restore|name local serial, room, level, bag, restore, name = string.match (line, "^map%s+([^|]+)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.*)$")
if not serial then -- v1.0 format: map serial room level name. No bag or restore was -- stored, so those stay nil and "rewrite" leaves the record alone -- rather than guessing what it was recorded with. serial, room, level, name = string.match (line, "^map%s+(%d+)%s+(%-?%d+)%s+(%d+)%s*(.*)$") bag, restore = nil, nil end
if serial then gMapped [trim (serial)] = { room = room, level = level, bag = (bag ~= "" and bag) or nil, restore = (restore ~= "" and restore) or nil, name = name, } end end end end
f:close () end
-- ===================================================================== -- invdata scan of the bag -- ===================================================================== local function stopScanTriggers () EnableTrigger ("pm_inv_header", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("pm_inv_body", false) end
local function beginScan (want) gScan = { want = want, items = {}, ticks = 0 } gStep = "scanning" EnableTrigger ("pm_inv_header", true) EnableTimer ("pm_tick", true) ResetTimer ("pm_tick") SendNoEcho ("invdata " .. gCfg.bag) end
function pmInvHeader (name, line, wildcards) -- Only ours: another plugin's inventory scan answers with a different -- container id, or with the bare "{invdata}" header this does not match. if not gScan then EnableTrigger ("pm_inv_header", false) return end if wildcards [1] ~= gCfg.bag then return end
EnableTrigger ("pm_inv_header", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("pm_inv_body", true) end
function pmInvItem (name, line, wildcards) if not gScan then return end table.insert (gScan.items, { serial = wildcards [1], flags = wildcards [2], name = stripColours (wildcards [3]), level = wildcards [4], itype = tonumber (wildcards [5]) or 0, }) end
-- forward declarations local nextPortal, finishRun, startRun
function pmInvFooter () stopScanTriggers () if not gScan then return end
local scan = gScan gScan = nil gStep = "idle" EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false)
-- Never trust our own list over the mapper's: forget anything we think -- is mapped that the mapper does not actually have. do local db = openMapperDb () if db then local dropped = 0 for _, item in ipairs (scan.items) do if item.itype == ITEM_TYPE_PORTAL and gMapped [item.serial] and exitInMapper (db, item.serial) == false then gMapped [item.serial] = nil dropped = dropped + 1 end end pcall (function () db:close () end) if dropped > 0 then saveData () echoWarn (dropped .. " portal(s) were recorded earlier but are NOT in " .. "'mapper portals' - they will be mapped again.") end end end
local portals, already, other = {}, 0, 0 for _, item in ipairs (scan.items) do if item.itype ~= ITEM_TYPE_PORTAL then other = other + 1 elseif gMapped [item.serial] then already = already + 1 else table.insert (portals, item) end end
if scan.want == "list" then echoHi ("bag ", tostring (gCfg.bag), " holds " .. #scan.items .. " item(s):") echoHi (" portals not yet mapped : ", tostring (#portals), "") echoHi (" portals already mapped : ", tostring (already), "") echoHi (" not portals (ignored) : ", tostring (other), "") for _, p in ipairs (portals) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-12s", p.serial), CLR_MSG, "", "L" .. p.level .. " " .. p.name) end return end
-- want == "run" if #portals == 0 then if already > 0 then echoHi ("nothing new in the bag - all ", tostring (already), " portal(s) in there are already mapped.") else echoHi ("no unmapped portals found in bag ", tostring (gCfg.bag), ".") end return end
gRun = { queue = portals, index = 0, stopping = false, done = 0, skipped = 0 } echoHi ("mapping ", tostring (#portals), " portal(s)" .. (already > 0 and (", skipping " .. already .. " already known") or "") .. ". 'portalmapper stop' halts after the current one.") nextPortal () end
-- ===================================================================== -- The run -- ===================================================================== local function sendRestore () SendNoEcho ("remove " .. gCurrent.serial) -- Deliberately Execute the ALIAS WORD rather than sending the command -- directly: the live run then exercises exactly the path the mapper will -- use later, so a broken alias shows up here and not weeks from now. Execute (restoreToken ()) Execute ("put " .. gCurrent.serial .. " " .. bagToken ()) end
function finishRun (why) gStep = "idle" gCurrent = nil EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false)
local run = gRun gRun = nil if not run then return end
echoHi (why .. " - mapped ", tostring (run.done), " portal(s)" .. (run.skipped > 0 and (", skipped " .. run.skipped) or "") .. ". Total known: " .. countMapped () .. ".") if (run.unverified or 0) > 0 then echoWarn (run.unverified .. " portal(s) were confirmed only by the mapper's" .. " message, not checked in its database - see 'mapper portals'.") end end
-- Walk the next portal in the queue. function nextPortal () if not gRun then return end
if gRun.stopping then finishRun ("Stopped") return end
gRun.index = gRun.index + 1 if gRun.index > #gRun.queue then finishRun ("Finished") return end
gCurrent = gRun.queue [gRun.index] gFromRoom = gRoomNum gTicks = 0 gSawSame = false gStep = "entering"
dbg ("portal " .. gCurrent.serial .. " from room " .. tostring (gFromRoom))
-- Execute, not Send: these go through the same aliases the mapper will -- use later, so the live run is a real test of the stored command. Execute ("get " .. gCurrent.serial .. " " .. bagToken ()) SendNoEcho ("wear " .. gCurrent.serial) SendNoEcho ("enter")
EnableTimer ("pm_tick", true) ResetTimer ("pm_tick") end
-- The mapper's answer was good (or at least not bad). Keep the record. local function recordDone (unverified) local rec = gRec gRec = nil if not rec then return end local portal = rec.portal
gMapped [portal.serial] = { room = rec.room, level = portal.level, bag = bagToken (), restore = restoreToken (), name = portal.name, } saveData ()
gStep = "idle" if not gRun then return end
gRun.done = gRun.done + 1 if unverified then gRun.unverified = (gRun.unverified or 0) + 1 end
ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%d/%d ", gRun.index, #gRun.queue), CLR_HI, "", portal.serial, CLR_MSG, "", " L" .. portal.level .. " " .. portal.name .. " -> room ", CLR_HI, "", rec.room, CLR_WARN, "", unverified and " (confirmed by mapper message only)" or "")
nextPortal () end
-- The mapper refused every attempt. Nothing was stored - say so and halt. local function recordFailed () local rec = gRec gRec = nil gStep = "idle" if not rec then return end
echoWarn ("the mapper would not store portal " .. rec.portal.serial .. " (" .. rec.portal.name .. ") - it was NOT recorded.") echo ("mapper said: " .. tostring (gRecFail or "(nothing)")) echo ("If it says the room is unknown, the mapper has no data for room " .. rec.room .. ": check the mapper plugin is enabled, 'look' there, " .. "then move somewhere you can portal from and: portalmapper resume")
local run = gRun gRun = nil gCurrent = nil if run then echoHi ("mapped ", tostring (run.done), " portal(s) this run.") end end
local function attemptRecord () if not gRec then return end gRecFail, gRecOk = nil, false gRecGen = gRecGen + 1
local cmd = portalCommand (gRec.portal.serial)
-- No "quiet": the mapper's "Storing ... as a portal" line is how we know -- it worked, and its FAILED line is how we know it did not. Execute ("mapper fullportal {" .. cmd .. "} {" .. gRec.room .. "} " .. gRec.portal.level)
DoAfterSpecial (REC_DELAY, "pmRecCheck (" .. gRecGen .. ")", 12) end
-- Called REC_DELAY seconds after each fullportal attempt. function pmRecCheck (gen) if not gRec or gen ~= gRecGen then return end
local inDb = nil local db = openMapperDb () if db then inDb = exitInMapper (db, gRec.portal.serial, gRec.room) pcall (function () db:close () end) end
if inDb == true then recordDone (false) return end
if inDb == nil and not gRecFail then -- cannot read the database: trust the mapper's own confirmation line, -- and nothing less. if gRecOk then recordDone (true) return end gRecFail = "(no confirmation from the mapper, and its database could not be read)" elseif not gRecFail then gRecFail = "(the exit is not in the mapper's portal list)" end
gRec.tries = gRec.tries + 1 if gRec.tries < REC_RETRIES then dbg ("not stored (" .. gRecFail .. "), retry " .. gRec.tries) attemptRecord () else recordFailed () end end
-- The mapper reports through print(), which is a Note. Notes cannot be -- trigger matched but they do pass through here. function OnPluginScreendraw (t, log, line) if not gRec or not line then return end if string.find (line, "PORTAL", 1, true) and string.find (line, "FAILED", 1, true) then gRecFail = line elseif string.find (line, "as a portal to room", 1, true) then gRecOk = true end end
-- We went somewhere. Record it (when we can) and carry on. local function arrived (roomNum) local portal = gCurrent gStep = "idle" EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false)
if roomNum == "-1" then -- A real move, but the mud will not give this room a number, so the -- mapper cannot hold an exit to it. Not a failure - just skip it. gRun.skipped = gRun.skipped + 1 echoWarn ("portal " .. portal.serial .. " leads somewhere unmappable " .. "(room -1) - not recorded, carrying on.") sendRestore () nextPortal () return end
-- Gear back on while we wait for the mapper; the next portal only starts -- once the mapper has answered for this one. gStep = "recording" gRec = { portal = portal, room = roomNum, tries = 0 } sendRestore () attemptRecord () end
-- "enter" did nothing. Almost always a noportal room. local function enterFailed () local portal = gCurrent gStep = "idle" EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false)
echoWarn ("Make sure you can enter portal here before typing portalmapper resume") echoHi ("stopped on portal ", portal.serial, " (" .. portal.name .. ") - it was NOT recorded.")
-- Honest reporting of the one case this cannot tell apart from a failure: -- a portal whose destination is the room you are already standing in. if gSawSame then echo ("(the mud re-sent this same room while waiting - if that portal " .. "leads right back here, it looks identical to a failure)") end
sendRestore ()
local run = gRun gRun = nil gCurrent = nil if run then echoHi ("mapped ", tostring (run.done), " portal(s) this run." .. " Move somewhere you can portal from, then: portalmapper resume") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- One second watchdog - the only thing it does is give up -- ===================================================================== function pmTick () if gStep == "entering" then gTicks = gTicks + 1 if gTicks >= ENTER_TIMEOUT then enterFailed () end return end
if gStep == "scanning" and gScan then gScan.ticks = gScan.ticks + 1 if gScan.ticks >= SCAN_TIMEOUT then local want = gScan.want gScan = nil gStep = "idle" stopScanTriggers () EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false) echoWarn ("no invdata reply for bag " .. tostring (gCfg.bag) .. " - is that the right bag id?") if want == "run" then echoHi ("check it with ", "portalmapper scan", "") end end return end
EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false) end
-- ===================================================================== -- GMCP room.info (telnet option 201) -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (theType, data) if theType ~= 201 then return end
local message = string.match (data, "^([%w%.%-_]+)") if not message then return end if string.lower (message) ~= "room.info" then return end
local num = string.match (data, '"num"%s*:%s*(%-?%d+)') if not num then return end
gRoomNum = num
if gStep == "entering" and num ~= gFromRoom then arrived (num) elseif gStep == "entering" then gSawSame = true dbg ("room.info still room " .. num .. ", waiting") end end
-- Read the current room without waiting for a move. local function syncRoom () if gHaveGmcpHelper then local ok, num = pcall (gmcp, "room.info.num") if ok and num ~= nil then gRoomNum = tostring (num) return true end pcall (Send_GMCP_Packet, "request room") end return false end
-- ===================================================================== -- Alias callbacks -- ===================================================================== function startRun () if gRun or gStep ~= "idle" then echo ("already running - 'portalmapper stop' to halt after this portal.") return end
local missing = missingConfig () if #missing > 0 then echoWarn ("not set up yet. Still needed:") for _, m in ipairs (missing) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", " " .. m) end echoHi ("full setup: ", "pmhelp", "") return end
local ready, why = mapperReady () if not ready then echoWarn (why .. " Nothing can be recorded without it.") return end
syncRoom () if not gRoomNum then echo ("I do not know what room you are in yet - type 'look' and try again.") return end if gRoomNum == "-1" then echoWarn ("this room has no room number, so nothing can be recorded from here.") echo ("move to a normal room and try again.") return end
beginScan ("run") end
function pmAliasGo () startRun () end
function pmAliasStop () if not gRun then echo ("not running.") return end gRun.stopping = true echo ("will stop once the current portal is finished.") end
function pmAliasScan () if gStep ~= "idle" then echo ("busy right now - try again when the run has stopped.") return end if not gCfg.bag then echoHi ("set the bag first: ", "portalmapper bag <id>", "") return end beginScan ("list") end
function pmAliasList () local n = countMapped () if n == 0 then echo ("no portals mapped yet.") return end
echoHi ("", tostring (n), " portal(s) on record:") local serials = {} for s in pairs (gMapped) do table.insert (serials, s) end table.sort (serials) local db = openMapperDb () local missing = 0 for _, s in ipairs (serials) do local m = gMapped [s] local gone = db and exitInMapper (db, s) == false if gone then missing = missing + 1 end ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-12s", s), CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("room %-8s L%-4s %s", m.room, m.level, m.name or ""), CLR_WARN, "", gone and " NOT IN MAPPER" or "") end if db then pcall (function () db:close () end) end if missing > 0 then echoWarn (missing .. " of those are not in 'mapper portals' - " .. "'portalmapper go' will map them again.") end echoHi ("re-map one with ", "portalmapper forget <serial>", "") end
function pmAliasForget (name, line, wildcards) local serial = wildcards [1] if not gMapped [serial] then echoHi ("not in the mapped list: ", serial, "") return end gMapped [serial] = nil saveData () echoHi ("forgotten ", serial, " - the next 'portalmapper go' will map it again.") echo ("(this does not remove the exit from the mapper - 'mapper portals' does that)") end
function pmAliasForgetAll () local n = countMapped () gMapped = {} saveData () echoHi ("cleared all ", tostring (n), " remembered portal(s).") echo ("(the mapper's own portal exits are untouched)") end
-- Say something if this change just orphaned previously recorded portals. local function warnIfStale () local stale = staleList () if #stale == 0 then return end echoWarn (#stale .. " portal(s) already in the mapper still use the old " .. "item numbers, so they would fail if walked.") echoHi ("fix them all with ", "portalmapper rewrite", " - no re-walking, it just edits the stored commands.") end
local function setSerial (which, label, value) gCfg [which] = value saveData () echoHi (label .. " set to ", value, "") local missing = missingConfig () if #missing == 0 then echoHi ("setup complete - run it with ", "portalmapper go", "") end warnIfStale () end
-- Re-point every already-recorded portal exit at the current bag and the -- current restore step, without walking anything. -- -- "mapper change portal {old} {new}" does an in-place UPDATE of the exit's -- command, keeping its destination and level (aard_GMCP_mapper.xml, -- map_portal_edit). Both strings go through Execute, so both use the same -- computed separator as everything else. function pmAliasRewrite () if gRun or gStep ~= "idle" then echo ("busy right now - try again when the run has stopped.") return end
local missing = missingConfig () if #missing > 0 then echoWarn ("set the bag and the restore item first - see pmhelp.") return end
local stale = staleList () if #stale == 0 then local unknown = 0 for _, m in pairs (gMapped) do if not (m.bag and m.restore) then unknown = unknown + 1 end end if unknown > 0 then echoHi ("nothing to rewrite, but ", tostring (unknown), " old record(s) predate this feature and do not say which bag " .. "they used - those have to be re-walked if the bag changed.") echoHi ("to re-walk them: ", "portalmapper forget all", " then portalmapper go") else echo ("nothing to rewrite - every recorded portal already matches your " .. "current bag and restore step.") end return end
local restore = restoreToken () local bag = bagToken () for _, serial in ipairs (stale) do local m = gMapped [serial] local oldCmd = portalCommandFor (serial, m.bag, m.restore) local newCmd = portalCommandFor (serial, bag, restore)
Execute ("mapper change portal {" .. oldCmd .. "} {" .. newCmd .. "}")
m.bag = bag m.restore = restore end
saveData () echoHi ("rewrote ", tostring (#stale), " portal exit(s) to use '" .. bag .. "' and '" .. restore .. "'.") echo ("the mapper prints one confirmation line per portal above.") end
-- "dualweapon" typed, or reached from a stored portal command. function pmAliasDoDual () if not gCfg.dualweapon then echoWarn ("no dual weapon set - portalmapper dualweapon <id>") return end SendNoEcho ("dual " .. gCfg.dualweapon) end
-- "wearportal" typed, or reached from a stored portal command. function pmAliasDoWear () if not gCfg.wearportal then echoWarn ("no wear-portal item set - portalmapper wearportal <id>") return end SendNoEcho ("wear " .. gCfg.wearportal) end
-- "get <serial> portalbag" / "put <serial> portalbag", from a stored -- portal command or typed by hand. local function bagOrComplain () if not gCfg.bag then echoWarn ("no portal bag set - portalmapper bag <id>") return nil end return gCfg.bag end
function pmAliasDoGet (name, line, wildcards) local bag = bagOrComplain () if bag then SendNoEcho ("get " .. wildcards [1] .. " " .. bag) end end
function pmAliasDoPut (name, line, wildcards) local bag = bagOrComplain () if bag then SendNoEcho ("put " .. wildcards [1] .. " " .. bag) end end
function pmAliasBag (name, line, wildcards) setSerial ("bag", "portal bag", wildcards [1]) end
function pmAliasDual (name, line, wildcards) setSerial ("dualweapon", "dual weapon", wildcards [1]) if gCfg.wish then echo ("note: wish mode is ON, so this is not currently used.") end end
function pmAliasWear (name, line, wildcards) setSerial ("wearportal", "wear-portal item", wildcards [1]) if not gCfg.wish then echo ("note: wish mode is OFF, so this is not currently used.") end end
function pmAliasWish (name, line, wildcards) local arg = string.lower (trim (wildcards [1] or ""))
if arg == "" then arg = gCfg.wish and "off" or "on" end
gCfg.wish = (arg == "on") saveData ()
if gCfg.wish then echoHi ("portal wish ", "ON", " - restore step: wearportal -> " .. restoreLive ()) if not gCfg.wearportal then echoHi ("still needed: ", "portalmapper wearportal <id>", "") end else echoHi ("portal wish ", "OFF", " - restore step: dualweapon -> " .. restoreLive ()) if not gCfg.dualweapon then echoHi ("still needed: ", "portalmapper dualweapon <id>", "") end end
warnIfStale () end
function pmAliasDebug () gDebug = not gDebug echoHi ("debug ", gDebug and "ON" or "OFF", gDebug and " - extra progress notes." or "") end
function pmAliasStatus () echoHi ("mode: ", gCfg.wish and "WISH" or "no wish", " restore step: " .. restoreToken () .. " -> " .. restoreLive ()) echoHi ("bag: ", tostring (gCfg.bag or "not set"), "") echoHi ("dual weapon: ", tostring (gCfg.dualweapon or "not set"), "") echoHi ("wear portal: ", tostring (gCfg.wearportal or "not set"), "") echoHi ("portals mapped: ", tostring (countMapped ()), "") local stale = staleList () if #stale > 0 then echoWarn (" " .. #stale .. " of them still name older gear - portalmapper rewrite") end echoHi ("current room: ", tostring (gRoomNum or "unknown"), "")
if gRun then echoHi ("RUNNING - portal ", gRun.index .. "/" .. #gRun.queue, gRun.stopping and " (stopping after this one)" or "") else echo ("idle.") end
local missing = missingConfig () if #missing > 0 then echoWarn ("not ready yet. Still needed:") for _, m in ipairs (missing) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", " " .. m) end end
echoHi ("commands: ", "pmhelp", "") end

-- ===================================================================== -- Lifecycle -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginInstall () loadData ()
gRun = nil gScan = nil gCurrent = nil gRec = nil gRecGen = gRecGen + 1 gStep = "idle" stopScanTriggers () EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false)
if IsConnected () then syncRoom () end
local missing = missingConfig () if #missing > 0 then Note ("") pmAliasHelp () Note ("") echoWarn ("not set up yet. Still needed:") for _, m in ipairs (missing) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", " " .. m) end else echoHi ("loaded - " .. countMapped () .. " portal(s) known. ", "portalmapper go", " to map new ones, pmhelp for commands.") end end
function OnPluginEnable () OnPluginInstall () end
local function shutdown () gRun = nil gScan = nil gCurrent = nil gRec = nil gRecGen = gRecGen + 1 gStep = "idle" stopScanTriggers () EnableTimer ("pm_tick", false) end
function OnPluginDisable () shutdown () end
function OnPluginClose () shutdown () end
function OnPluginConnect () syncRoom () end
function OnPluginDisconnect () if gRun then echoWarn ("disconnected mid-run - the rest was not mapped.") end shutdown () end
